name: indonli_benchmark
description: Indonli_benchmark is a benchmark for Indonesian natural language understanding, centered on natural language inference tasks in Indonesian. It measures models' ability to determine semantic relations (entailment, contradiction, neutral) between sentence pairs in Indonesian. The dataset is intended to evaluate language models' Indonesian NLU capabilities across standardized accuracy metrics.
reputation: Used within the Indonesian NLP community as a standard NLI evaluation; moderate adoption outside the locale-specific research community.
